chunks: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Saleh, [who] said: 'O my people, worship God; you have no other god but He. It is He who raised you from the earth and settled you upon it. So beg your Lord to forgive you, and turn to Him in repentance. Surely my Lord is near and answers.'

key_terms.صَالِحاً: Saleh, the prophet sent to Thamud

ai.seo_question: What was the core message of Prophet Saleh to the people of Thamud?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'istamara' (made them dwell) highlights human stewardship over the earth, linking physical creation with spiritual responsibility. The verse underscores the immediacy of divine response to repentance, a key theme in Shia spirituality regarding the closeness of Allah to the supplicant.
